entities.summary: The Battle of Gorjani or Battle of Đakovo was fought on 9 October 1537 at Gorjani, a place in Slavonia, between the towns of Đakovo and Valpovo, as part of the Little War in Hungary as well as the Hundred Years' Croatian–Ottoman War.
